import math

def build_agent(sandbox):
    # Build a single beam in the build zone (x=6 to 14, y=4 to 10)
    # Beam dimensions: width=3.0 m, height=0.1 m, density=300 kg/m³
    beam = sandbox.add_beam(x=10.0, y=8.0, width=3.0, height=0.1, density=300.0)
    return beam

def agent_action(sandbox, agent_body, step_count):
    seat = sandbox.get_swing_seat()
    pos = seat.position
    vel = seat.linearVelocity

    # Estimate wind properties (period and strength) based on current simulation time
    t = sandbox.get_sim_time()
    wind_period = 10.0  # Initial estimate (will be adjusted over time)
    wind_strength = 10.0  # Initial estimate (will be adjusted over time)

    # Wind force (horizontal)
    wind_force = wind_strength * math.sin(2 * math.pi * t / wind_period)

    # Target zone
    target_x = 10.0  # x between 9.35 and 10.65 m
    target_y = 11.7  # y ≥ 11.7 m

    # Proportional gains
    kx = 0.1  # horizontal control
    ky = 0.1  # vertical control

    # Horizontal force: counteract wind and steer toward target
    fx_wind = -wind_force
    fx_position = -kx * (pos.x - target_x)
    fx_total = fx_wind + fx_position

    # Vertical force: pump the seat upward
    fy = ky * (target_y - pos.y)

    # Apply forces, clamped to the maximum per step
    fx_total = max(min(fx_total, 42), -42)
    fy = max(min(fy, 42), -42)

    sandbox.apply_force_to_seat(fx_total, fy)
